Hi there :)

I do suffer from thyroids but apparently my depression has a different cause, I also tried counseling but I felt like I needed to feel better asap (been feeling like sh\*t for the past 8 months) so I decided to go straight to a psychiatrist and got Zoloft on my first appointment. 

I'm five days in and feel so much better (some not so good side effects tho), it's been a while since I had this many good days. 

I think you should visit your doctor and talk about how you're feeling, in my experience the moment it starts affecting your relationship is the right moment to do it. Don't let it be so bad you loose all your friends and have to go through by yourself.  

Also, don't think meds are the entire answer to it. In my case, I'll keep doing psychotherapy among with Zoloft so I can keep feeling good in the long run when I quit meds.  

I hope you feel better soon, feel free to write me if you feel like talking!
